dataset: synthetic test split: 40 bundles (b0160–b0199), 275 documents; hard cases: 20
caveat: Measured on our synthetic generator's test split and hand-made hard cases; overstates real-document accuracy; real-document evaluation is pilot month 1.
note: Pipeline functions called directly (no database, LLM off). Borrower STIR and application date are given as known to the bank. Definitions: eval/metrics.py and docs/EVAL.md.

latency_environment.note: laptop, documents processed in parallel; production latency comes from server job timings
